newsitem.title: UK: Raytheon set to win Hughes - FT.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon set to win Hughes - FT.

text.p: Raytheon Co is expected to be victorious in its bid for Hughes Electronics' defence operations after giving weekend briefings to General Motors which is selling the business, the Financial Times reported on Monday.
The newspaper said final bids for the Hughes business of between $9.5 billion and $10 billion were submitted by Raytheon and rival bidder Northrop Grumman.
On Friday, a Raytheon spokesman declined to comment to Reuters on newspaper reports it had raised its bid to around $10 billion.
The Financial Times said GM's capital committee, after meeting with GM adviser Goldman Sachs over the weekend, was submitting its recommendation to a full GM board meeting on Monday.

"The board is likely to approve the committee's proposal as most senior executives sit on both bodies," the newspaper said. "An announcement is likely to be made in New York after the meeting." it added.
